title: Prompt-aware alignment
description: The person's hypotheses, set against observations that already exist. The request that carries this schema contains NO IMAGE PART. That absence — not the instruction above it — is what makes a new visual observation impossible in this pass. Every claim must cite the observation ids it used, and an id that does not exist is recorded as a hallucinated citation rather than quietly dropped.

claim.description: One hypothesis of the person's, restated as a single claim. Theirs, not the model's.

stance.description: The five the directive names. `does_not_bear_on` (the observations are about something else) and `cannot_determine` (the observations are about the right thing and do not settle it) are different findings, and a schema with only one of them would force the model to lie about which.

observation_ids.description: Ids from the observation digest. Empty is legitimate for does_not_bear_on and is not treated as a failure.

grounds.description: Why that stance, said in terms of the cited observations. Audited for terms present in neither the observations nor the person's own words.
